proposal.summary: Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25 allow XML External Entity (XXE) attacks leading to information disclosure; fixed in firmware LW80.*.P246 (P246 or higher).
proposal.cwe_quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

C.quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain and apply firmware LW80.*.P246 (or later) for affected models; if patching is not immediately possible, block or filter XML inputs to device services and review logs for exfiltration indicators.

evidence_quotes.quote: allow XXE attacks, leading to information disclosure.
Certain Lexmark devices (such as CS310) before 2023-08-25

The fixed firmware version is LW80.*.P246, i.e., '*' indicates that the full version specification varies across product model family, but firmware level P246 (or higher) is required to remediate the vulnerability.
